verdict.rationale: Pigment documents the main ingredients from the live model. The Analyst Agent builds reports from conversations, variance analysis runs on the same platform as the budget and flags the reasons behind gaps, KPIs can be configured, and dashboards and reporting tools are available. Nothing shows these being assembled into a board pack or slide-style deliverable, so it delivers the inputs rather than a generated board pack. Missing for 10: a documented board-pack or presentation generation/export feature, evidence of auto-generated variance commentary in a board-ready format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
